findings.evidence: Diff body: `simp only [cechXIso_hom_π]\n  rfl`. The type of `g` is `P.obj (op ((unop ((FormalCoproduct.mk _ U).cech.rightOp.obj ⦋n⦌)).obj a))`, while the `Pi.π` from `cechXIso` targets `∏ᶜ fun j ↦ U (a j)`.
findings.fix: Add a comment naming the definitional reduction (`FormalCoproduct.cech`/`rightOp` object at `⦋n⦌` evaluated at `a`). Better, state that object equality once as an explicit `rfl` lemma and prove the iff from it, instead of `simp` followed by `rfl`.
findings.issue: `cechXIso_comp_π_eq_iff` ends with `simp only [cechXIso_hom_π]` followed by a bare `rfl`. The `rfl` silently identifies `P.obj (op (∏ᶜ fun j ↦ U (a j)))` with the `(FormalCoproduct.mk _ U).cech.rightOp` tuple target. That is the definitional equality the lemma exists to package, and nothing records why it holds. The Coefficients and Functor consumers depend on it.

findings.evidence: Lines 138–139: `simpa only [cechComplexCompIso, ..., prodIso, asIso_hom, piComparison] using compXIso_hom_π G U Q hG n a`. `prodIso` is `asIso (piComparison G fun j ↦ U (a j))` (Functor.lean:78–81).
findings.fix: Use the characteristic `@[simp]` lemmas, `isoOfComponents_hom_f` plus `prodIso`'s `asIso_hom`, and `piComparison_comp_π`/`Pi.lift` extensionality, rather than unfolding `cechComplexCompIso` and `piComparison`. Alternatively, state `compXIso_hom_π` with the `Pi.lift` form directly so no unfolding is needed.
findings.issue: The new public `cechComplexCompIso_hom_f_comp_cechXIso_hom_π` is proved by `simpa only [cechComplexCompIso, HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents_hom_f, prodIso, asIso_hom, piComparison] using compXIso_hom_π …`. This `simpa` unfolds a definition, a private iso and Mathlib's `piComparison` just to match a goal, so any change to those definitions breaks it. It also replaces what was a one-line term proof of `cechComplexCompIso_hom_f_π` with a two-lemma detour.

findings.fix: Use `simpa only [sectionsIsoCechZero_hom, Category.assoc] using (leftHomologyDataSucc ι hK n).π_comp_homologyIso_inv`, with the existing comment explaining that the `π` field is the composite.
findings.issue: `leftHomologyDataSucc_π_comp_homologyIso_inv` replaces a `simpa` with a hand-built `.symm.trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans …)` associativity term. This is the shape-dependent pattern flagged in the previous round.

summary: The new canonical bridge lemma `cechXIso_comp_π_eq_iff` closes with an uncommented `simp only` followed by `rfl`, which relies on definitional equality to identify the two dependent targets, and the new comparison coordinate lemma is proved by a `simpa` that unfolds four definitions. Both are reused by later proofs, so their brittleness spreads.
